successors.note: No dossier; the Northern Nigeria Protectorate (1900-1914, about 660,000 km2 in 1912) belongs to the Sahel/savanna groups (af-03).

capitals.name: Lokoja
capitals.note: Placeholder: the Royal Niger Company page names no headquarters; Lokoja is the Niger-Benue confluence station it mentions (founded 1857) and 'Lokoja was the capital from 1900' (Northern Nigeria page).

correction.text: the Company's stations on the lower Niger and at the Niger-Benue confluence: Onitsha (an outpost since 1879) and Lokoja

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. The page gives no extent, no area and no treaty list for the territories (the chartered territories 'became the Northern and Southern Nigeria protectorates'); 50 km circles round Onitsha and Lokoja are stand-ins for the river stations and are far smaller than the sphere the charter covered.

correction.text: the Company's stations plus Ilorin, 'occupied by the Royal Niger Company in 1897'

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: a 60 km circle round Ilorin added; the Ilorin page gives no month and no extent of the emirate.

region.text: its stations on the Niger and the Benue, Onitsha and Lokoja

ledger.note: 1886 (July): the Royal Niger Company is chartered. 'The charter was granted in July 1886, and the company became the Royal Niger Company'; formed in 1879 as the United African Company, renamed in 1881 and 1886; by October 1884 it had bought out its rival firms' interests in the region.

1897: the Company occupies Ilorin. The city 'was occupied by the Royal Niger Company in 1897'; its lands 'were incorporated into the British Northern Nigeria Protectorate in 1900'. The Ilorin page has no month.

region.text: the Company's territories south of Lokoja

ledger.note: 1900 (1 January): the southern territories go to Southern Nigeria. 'The territory became the Northern and Southern Nigeria protectorates' (Royal Niger Company page); Southern Nigeria absorbed the Company's territories 'south of Lokoja' (Southern Nigeria page). Onitsha as the southern part is the researcher's reading.

region.text: the Company's territories at and north of Lokoja, with Ilorin

ledger.note: 1900 (1 January): the northern territories go to the Northern Nigeria Protectorate. 'On 1 January 1900, the Royal Niger Company's charter was revoked' (Northern Nigeria page: protectorate established 1 January 1900, 'Lokoja was the capital from 1900').
1900 (1 January): the Royal Niger Company's rule ends. It later became the Niger Company Ltd and, in 1929, part of the United Africa Company.

certainty.note: No page gives the Company's territory; the shapes are two circles standing for river stations. The charter sphere covered far more by treaty.

sources.title: Royal Niger Company
sources.note: Formed 1879, renamed 1881 and 1886, charter July 1886, charter revoked 1899, transfer 1 January 1900 for 865,000 pounds, becoming the Northern and Southern Nigeria protectorates; Onitsha outpost 1879; no extent.

sources.title: Northern Nigeria Protectorate
sources.note: Established 1 January 1900, Lokoja the capital from 1900, Zungeru 1902, about 660,000 km2 in 1912; the Company is not in the infobox.

sources.title: Ilorin
sources.note: Occupied by the Royal Niger Company in 1897; lands incorporated into the Northern Nigeria Protectorate in 1900.

sources.title: Southern Nigeria Protectorate
sources.note: Formed 1 January 1900 from the Niger Coast Protectorate and the Company's territories south of Lokoja.

notes: The Royal Niger Company has no Cliopatria row. Three pages opened; none gives the territory, the treaties (the page has no figure for them) or a headquarters, so the two circles and the Lokoja capital dot are placeholders (confidence low). The charter was revoked in 1899 and the territories transferred on 1 January 1900 (no war). The company's wars (the Nupe and Ilorin campaigns of 1897, the Akassa raid of 1895) are not on the page. The Northern Nigeria Protectorate is named as a successor without a dossier; it is a savanna state for the af-03 (Sahel) or af-08 group. Whether a chartered company belongs on the map as a state is for the colour/renderer agents; type 'colony' stands for 'ruled from elsewhere'.
